layers.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent fitted costume animation overlay for Ratlantis, NOT an inventory icon. Reference image 1 is the exact player rat animation atlas, three columns and two rows. Keep the same canvas aspect 3:2 and the exact six cell positions, directions, and sizes: top row standing/right-facing, walking A/right-facing, walking B/right-facing; bottom row leaping/right-facing, rearing/right-facing, seated/right-facing. First imagine the SAME rat in each exact pose wearing a tiny worn brass bottle-cap crown, snug on top of the skull between the ears, with ears free. Render ONLY that fitted costume/prop in each of the six cells; remove ALL rat fur, body, face, skin, paws, tail and backpack so these are completely transparent. This is a paper-doll overlay registered to the provided rat atlas, not six separate floating inventory illustrations. Each item MUST stay at the exact original body location it would occupy on that reference rat, including the very different head heights and body positions per pose. Keep generous transparent blank space everywhere else. Do not center the item within its cell: align it to the corresponding rat body landmark from the reference! Same rough pen-and-ink linework, gouache texture, warm muted gold highlights and deep navy. Each garment has appropriate perspective and folds for that pose. No rat remnants, no text, no grid, no shadows or background. Genuine alpha transparency. Wide 1536x1024 sheet with six 512x512 cells if possible.

portraits: Use case: illustration-story. Create a transparent 3 by 3 sheet of nine fully drawn standing player-rat costume portraits for Ratlantis. Image 1 is the exact rat anatomy, fur, ink-and-gouache style and little backpack reference. Image 2 supplies costume concepts. Same right-facing reared-up natural rat standing on tiny short hind paws in every cell, rounded pear-shaped furry body, long tail, black bead eyes, pointed muzzle, no human legs. Same rat same scale same ground baseline per square cell, whole tail and costume inside each cell with clear transparent margins. Each cell shows rat WEARING or HOLDING ONE fitted item, not an icon floating nearby. Row 1 left-to-right: tiny bottle-cap brass crown between ears; folded cream paper sailor hat between ears; small thimble helmet with chin strap and ears free. Row2: short navy patched cape fastened around neck over backpack; snug cream/navy patchwork vest around torso under backpack straps; muted amber diagonal ribbon sash around torso. Row3: tiny matchstick staff gripped in forepaws; tiny blunt teaspoon stage sword gripped in forepaws; tiny cream cloth/button flower held in forepaws. No extra clothing, no words, no backgrounds, no grid lines. Cohesive navy/gold illustrated art matching the supplied player exactly, genuine alpha transparency. Square sheet 1536x1536 if possible, nine evenly sized square frames.
